test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 27 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: A toy is in the form of a cone mounted on a hemisphere, both having the same radius of 7 cm. If the volume of the conical part is equal to the volume of the hemispherical part, what is the total height of the toy?
solution:
__Shortcut Trick__
For a **toy** where **Volume of Cone** = **Volume of Hemisphere** with the same **radius** (r):

(1/3) × π × r² × h = (2/3) × π × r³ ⇒ h = 2r.

The **total height** of the toy is the sum of the **cone height** (h) and **hemisphere radius** (r):

Total Height = h + r = 2r + r = 3r.

Given r = 7 cm, Total Height = 3 × 7 = 21 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 21 cm.**

**__Alternate Method__**

⇒ **Given**: **Radius** (r) of both **cone** and **hemisphere** = 7 cm.

⇒ **Formula Used**: **Volume of Cone** = (1/3)πr²h | **Volume of Hemisphere** = (2/3)πr³.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d0aa655b14bb6f1f723d258ea87bcccc495aae8e71d9cbd43655fab04599d34.png] 
⇒ Volume of **conical part** = Volume of **hemispherical part**

⇒ (1/3) × π × r² × h = (2/3) × π × r³

⇒ (1/3) × π × 7² × h = (2/3) × π × 7³

⇒ h = 2 × 7

⇒ h = 14 cm

⇒ **Total height** of the **toy** = Height of **cone** (h) + Radius of **hemisphere** (r)

⇒ Total height = 14 + 7 = 21 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 21 cm.**

**__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Sphere

The volume of a complete **sphere** is (4/3) × π × r³. A **hemisphere** is exactly half of this volume.

Slant Height of a Cone

The **slant height** (l) is the distance from the apex to any point on the base circle: l = √(h² + r²).

Curved Surface Area (CSA)

For the toy, Total CSA = CSA of **cone** (πrl) + CSA of **hemisphere** (2πr²).</p
